cases.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP): TAF1-32i intron retention and promoter repression
cases.mechanism_detail: The SVA reduces TAF1 expression and increases the NMD-sensitive intron-retention transcript TAF1-32i in patient cells and blood (normalised by SVA excision); the region carries epigenetic marks and the SVA represses the TAF1 promoter in reporter assays.
cases.quote: A SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA) retrotransposon inserted in an intron of the TAF1 gene reduces its expression and alters splicing in XDP patient-derived cells.
